consequence.statement: A UI bug is fixed so an app with both name and server destination can be added; no operator action is stated.

original.statement: A UI bug fix: the Argo CD UI could not add an application that has both name and server destination; this is now fixed.

decision.reason: [ev-5cbf04b8633d] lists this only as a UI bug fix under "Bug fixes": the UI can now add an app that has both a name and a server destination. The evidence does not say anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or needs migrating, and doing nothing just means the fix applies. So "none" (informational) fits the evidence.
